mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 50th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending confidence and corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market strength, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 75th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) falling below 1,600,000 units signal a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST < 1600.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicate systemic supply chain disruptions and economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending momentum, supporting corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS is above its 75th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
